section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Working game title
description: $POTIFY: A Wonderful High Life; short universe label POTIFY City, with title treatment of A Wonderful High Life.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Central genre
description: Original cozy 3D farming/life simulator rooted in early-2000s GameCube-era pacing and controls, set in a fictional cannabis-growing city.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Inspirational lineage
description: Emulate the feeling of Harvest Moon: A Wonderful Life and some Animal Crossing social exploration; do not reproduce copyrighted code, maps, layouts, characters, music or art assets.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: The city is the farm
description: Small grow plot or rooftop greenhouse at first; a living neighborhood and progressively larger property replace the traditional inherited farm.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Daily life first
description: In-world movement, chores, seasons, conversation, shopping, sleeping and meaningful passage of time drive gameplay.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Grow–harvest–sell–upgrade
description: The repeatable backbone of the game: acquire fictional genetics and supplies, care for virtual plants, harvest, sell, expand.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Seed → Soil → Solana
description: Canonical POTIFY motto may appear subtly on books, signs, murals, ending titles and the journal.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: The city has history
description: Small details should imply that the town existed before the player arrived; do not explain every mystery with exposition.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Wonder without glitter
description: Calm, grounded, witty, inhabited; little magical moments are rare and earn their impact.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Shylo's identity
description: Shylo is a gray/cream Norwegian Elkhound with pointed ears and a curled tail; ambient supporting companion, not the central mascot.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Fictional commerce
description: The game does not sell, deliver, redeem or enable purchases of real-world cannabis.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: No financial promises
description: Gameplay achievements, lore and Easter eggs do not promise real crypto, price appreciation or holder rewards.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Work in public
description: Publish honest visual concepts, feature progress and changelogs without leaking puzzle answers or calling concepts finished gameplay.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Clear feature status
description: User requests, concept art, assigned Replit work and actually verified playable functions are different evidence levels.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: No platform claims
description: No Steam, Epic, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo or other distribution support can be claimed without a verified release plan/approval.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: GLP separation
description: GreenLight Pay is unrelated to the fictional game economy and never presented as payment processing or token utility for this game.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: The first scene
description: Wake in a modest room, notice a written task list, step into early morning, and survey a neglected growing space.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Emotional arc
description: Player learns responsibility through failure, rebuilding, friendships, and incremental improvements—not fast-money fireworks.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Game identity shorthand
description: From one rooftop (or modest plot) to a living city, with a long-term chapter of stewardship rather than an instant empire.

section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
title: Final IP and game publisher structure
description: Working title and design are set; trademark/rights, age ratings, official business ownership and platform agreements require separate verification.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: GameCube-era mood
description: Muted stylized 3D inspired by original A Wonderful Life rather than bright mobile anime or modern high-saturation remake aesthetics.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Grounded colors
description: Worn olive, hay, dirt brown, weathered timber, concrete, brick, washed blue, soft yellow daylight, restrained green.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: No pink-first city
description: Avoid pink or lavender-dominated skies, giant cherry blossoms, pastel kawaii UI, glitter, neon everywhere.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: People look like residents
description: Modestly proportioned original 3D characters, readable silhouettes, worn practical clothes, human expressions.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: UI serves the chores
description: Real-time scene takes priority over menus; small tool/status HUD; only contextual dialogue and shop panels when needed.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: No poster-as-gameplay
description: Splash artwork is not proof of a 3D world; screenshots should come from the actual game when called gameplay.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Originalized reference
description: Use user-approved calmer concept board as guiding composition, with actual game props and work replacing decorative UI panels.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Third-person camera
description: Slightly above-and-behind follow camera, gentle perspective, manual turn and restrained distance options.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Weathering and aging
description: Wood chips, weather stains, dusty shelves, slightly crooked signs, used tools, creek stones, weeds between paving stones.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Interior lighting
description: Greenhouse daylight and subtle magenta grow lights only where justified; softer shadows indoors.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Sky and clouds
description: Blue-gray mornings, warm amber evenings, genuine dusk; cloud coverage changes by weather.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Plant silhouettes
description: Obvious visual difference between small vegetative plants, flowering plants and harvest-ready crops.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Shopfront typography
description: Painted shop signs and parchment-style tooltips; not huge hovering branded signs on every corner.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Journal graphics
description: Handwritten notebook, worn paper tabs, pressed-leaf bookmarks and map annotation stickers.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Map design
description: Hand-drawn village/district sketch with discovered locations; no false claims that all neighborhoods are unlocked.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Character portrait restraint
description: Optional dialogue portraits, original design, no oversized chibi eyes.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Visible domesticity
description: A sink, bed, dirty boots, calendar, kettle, hallway, shelf and meaningful storage.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Gentle animations
description: Breathing, head turns, routine idle behavior, watering, sorting harvests, sweeping, opening storefronts.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: An imperfect town
description: Trucks, billboards, fences, service alleys, little hill trails and quiet water rather than an amusement park.

section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
title: Visual reward cadence
description: Big reveal for a building upgrade or first harvest; everything else subtle.

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: The Labs

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: The Underground

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Rooftop Walkways

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: The Canal Walk

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Backstreet Courtyard
description: Small everyday location for deliveries, trash bins, murals and subtle hidden triggers.

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Home lane
description: Starter house or apartment connected to starter grow space by a walkable path.

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Local buses and tram
description: Potential schedule-based transport after walking map exists and is satisfying.

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Bicycle
description: Optional mobility upgrade, with safe street-level route rules.

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Day-night city routes
description: Vendors change posts, street lamps operate and some gates close with time.

section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
title: Definitive layout
description: Exact relative positions and travel times remain design work; concept maps are not canonical exact geometries.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: POTIFY Dispensary
description: Fictional in-world buyer for virtual harvest, not a real dispensary or real-world transaction link.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: The Grow Shop
description: Practical equipment, fans and lighting upgrades, maintenance tasks and price board.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Genetics Lab
description: Research table, small original mini-games, hybrid trait records and lab NPC arc.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Research Annex
description: Optional Chapter 2 site where rare genetics clues, lost records and town history converge.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Town Market Stalls
description: Limited opening hours and scheduled market days.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: The Soil Cafe
description: Neighborhood social meeting spot; menu and NPC schedules rather than real-world commerce.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: The Lounge
description: Music and nighttime conversation, low-key ambience, optional non-player events.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: DJ Booth
description: Town-owned community venue with audio collectibles and rotating performances.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Mechanic's Shop
description: Roof repairs, generators, plumbing upgrades and broken irrigation line quests.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Archive and Library
description: Books, paper archives, local photographs, Chronicle excerpts, book lending.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Warehouse
description: Expansion from handmade work to larger operation, maintaining resource/time constraints.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Cold Storage
description: Product inventory, spoilage timers as game mechanics, sorting and packing.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Friend's Apartment
description: An unlockable interior for a meaningful NPC story rather than endless identical interiors.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: The Old Observatory
description: Rooftop quiet place, astronomy and long-distance city vista; secret unlock candidate.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: The Arcade
description: Retro local venue; candidate for an original playable Vape God reference.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: The Inn
description: Temporary visitor rooms and seasonal arrivals; only if NPC system supports traveler schedules.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Extra farm lots
description: Multiple properties across districts, each with distinct tradeoffs.

section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
title: Community Greenhouse
description: Optional cooperative narrative project without real token payouts.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Time matters
description: Daily obligations, routines and changing locations should be meaningful—not merely a timer icon.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Four seasons
description: Spring, summer, autumn, winter with distinct color, environment, market stock and schedule patterns.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Short seasons
description: Candidate 10 game days per season during early testing; tunable for gameplay satisfaction.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Day progression
description: Approx. 12–18 minutes per game day unless the player sleeps or enters a controlled time skip.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Sleep to advance
description: Player enters bed and begins next morning; crop state, calendar, weather and NPC schedules update.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Morning ritual
description: Check calendar, weather, plants and supplies before choosing route.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Shop hours
description: Doors may be closed outside business hours; clock becomes meaningful.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: NPC commuting
description: Shopkeepers open/close, eat, visit market and return home; route schedules persist by day.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Weather state
description: Sun, cloud and rain; changes ambience, growth modifiers, water availability and schedule decisions.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Outdoor shelter
description: Open plots and greenhouses respond differently to rain, wind and winter.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Temperature abstraction
description: Simple season/environment suitability modifier, not a real-world cultivation instruction manual.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Player stamina
description: Watering, cleaning and chores consume a manageable resource, restored by sleep or simple meals.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Reputation passage
description: Residents remember years of events and completed chores.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Seasonal renovations
description: Storefronts, town banners, market stalls and props change incrementally.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Birthdays
description: NPC calendar birthdays provide small optional relationship moments.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Seasonal visitors
description: Traveling vendor or archivist arrives on certain weeks.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Calendar journal
description: Appointment, event, crop estimate and daily note page.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Rainy afternoon
description: Slower streets, cover sounds, conversations that vary with weather.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Generational epilogue
description: Long-running town changes could culminate in an epilogue rather than an infinite wealth grind.

section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
title: Weather emergencies
description: Power outage or leaks as accessible fictional maintenance quests, with no unsafe real-world repair instructions.

title: Cannabis-inspired fiction
description: Virtual cannabis varieties form the main crop category and visual identity of the game.

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
title: Hands-on care loop
description: Approach actual 3D plot, ready tool, sow, water, inspect, wait, harvest and see consequences.

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
title: Seeds as inventory
description: Varieties with visual packet labels, prices, simple traits and quantities.

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
title: Watering can

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
title: Basic soil supplies
description: Consumable item associated with plot condition, accessible fictional simplification.

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
title: Plant health
description: Visual and journal feedback, can recover under normal player care.

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
title: Growth stages
description: Seed / sprout / vegetative / flowering / ripe / harvested, visually distinct.

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
